info.name: SSM Merchant API
info.description: SSM mobile API for the **Merchant** app. Auth: opaque bearer token from `POST /auth/vendor/login` (`vendor_type: owner`). Approval gate: pending merchants can only use onboarding routes. Import together with `SSM_PRODUCTION.postman_environment.json` (or `SSM_LOCAL` for a local server). Full guide: docs/postman/SSM_MERCHANT_API.md.

item.name: 04 Orders
item.description: Orders for the authenticated merchant's store only. Lifecycle: `pending_merchant` → accept → `accepted` → start-preparing → `preparing` → ready-for-pickup → `ready_for_pickup` (dispatch to Drivers then starts automatically: `dispatching`). "New orders" are `current-orders` with `ssm_status = pending_merchant`; "Active orders" are the other non-terminal ones; "History" is `completed-orders`. Mutations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header and an optional `expected_version` (stale version → 409).

exec: try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { json = null; }

if (!pm.environment.get('order_id')) { const candidates = json.filter(o => o.ssm_status === 'pending_merchant'); if (candidates[0]) pm.environment.set('order_id', String(candidates[0].id)); if (candidates[1]) pm.environment.set('order_reject_id', String(candidates[1].id)); }
pm.test('Every order has a canonical status', function () { json.forEach(o => pm.expect(o.ssm_status).to.be.a('string')); });

pm.test('Placed order is listed as pending_merchant or later', function () { const mine = json.find(o => String(o.id) === pm.environment.get('order_id')); if (mine) { pm.expect(['pending_merchant','accepted','preparing','ready_for_pickup','dispatching','driver_assigned','driver_accepted','picked_up','out_for_delivery']).to.include(mine.ssm_status); } });
pm.test('No commission or wallet fields', function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(json)).to.not.match(/commission|admin_expense|delivery_man_wallet/i); });
pm.test('Customer e-mail is not disclosed to the merchant', function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(json)).to.not.match(/contact_person_email/); });

item.name: 06 Pharmacy Requests
item.description: A merchant sees only requests addressed to its own store. Recommended flow: quote (`/quote`) and let the customer accept or reject; `/reject` declines the request. The legacy one-step `/price` (prices and creates the order immediately) is opt-in. The prescription is a private stream: the stored path is never returned.
